newsitem.title: USA: New York executive charged with wife's murder.
newsitem.headline: New York executive charged with wife's murder.

text.p: A 62-year-old advertising executive has been charged with murdering his wife, whose body was found in a shallow grave, police said on Saturday.

Sheldon Wasserman was charged with second degree murder in the stabbing death of his wife, Carol Wasserman, 58. Police said she had been stabbed numerous times. Her body was found Friday in a shallow grave on commercial property the couple owned in Pompton Plains, N.J., a suburb about 20 miles west of Manhattan.
The Wassermans had been married 40 years and lived in a high-rise apartment building on the upper East Side of New York City, across the street from Sotheby's auction house.

Last Monday, Wasserman reported his wife missing to New York City police. At first, police said they did not consider him a suspect, but later in the week they obtained a search warrant from New Jersey authorities and then found the body.
Police became suspicious of Wasserman after he gave conflicting stories to detectives during repeated questionings, a police spokeswoman said.
Police also said they had received a tip that Wasserman had purchased a shovel earlier in the week.
